promotionSurvey.run: OH-PROM-O 2026-09-09: property survey of the 27 committed captures against the 12 registered vectors. Every capture was re-read; no capture was taken and no POST/PUT/DELETE issued (the oracle was on a moving business date, held by OH-INV-N).
promotionSurvey.verdict: No further genuinely-uncovered money property is reachable from the 27 committed captures without a fresh capture. The run's two new vectors pin the three uncovered properties that DO exist (P1 waiver-unmoved balance, P2 accrual absent-not-zero, P3 principal-derived running balance) via the loan-transaction-balance seam; every remaining uncited capture is a write-path echo, a byte/whole-file clone of a covered read-back, a template with no money cell, or a duplicate list, and is recorded below so the next agent does not re-survey it.
